title: High-Protein Butter Chicken Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cubed
12 oz cavatappi or elbow macaroni (or chickpea protein pasta)
Marinade: 1/2 cup 0% Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 1.5 tsp garam masala, 1.5 tsp Kashmiri chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp turmeric, salt

Butter Chicken Cheese Sauce: 1 tbsp butter, 1 cup tomato passata/crushed tomatoes, 1/2 cup blended cottage cheese or light cream, 1.5 cups shredded mozzarella & sharp cheddar, 1 tsp kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves)
instructions: Toss cubed chicken with the Greek yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices; sear in a hot skillet or air-fry at 400°F for 10 minutes until charred.
Boil the macaroni in salted water until al dente and drain.

In the skillet, simmer butter, tomato passata, garam masala, and kasuri methi for 5 minutes. Turn heat to low and stir in blended cottage cheese (or cream) and shredded cheddar/mozzarella until velvety.
Fold the cooked macaroni and charred chicken into the creamy butter chicken cheese sauce, top with extra mozzarella, broil 2 minutes, and garnish with cilantro.
